units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 1:4">Makhsh. I, 4</cite> <he>הנוֹעֵר אגודה וכ׳</he> he who shakes (the rain off) a bundle of vegetables.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 5:7">Ib. V, 7</cite>.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 26:1">Pesik. R. s. 26</cite> <he>לאיוב נָעַרְתִּי מן האשפה וכ׳</he> I shook Job (making him rise) from the dunghill, and concerning thee (Israel) it is written (<cite ref="Isaiah 52:2">Is. LII, 2</cite>), shake thyself &c.; a. e.

senses.gloss: to shake. Pesik. Shek., p. 17ᵃ נַעֲרָהּ קפלה shake it (the garment), fold it; Lev. R. s. 2.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:8">B. Mets. II, 8</cite> <he>מצא כסות מְנַעֲרָהּ וכ׳</he> if one found a garment (and holds it in charge waiting for the owner to claim it), he must shake it once in thirty days.
<cite ref="Shabbat 147a">Sabb. 147ᵃ</cite> top; a. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 8:3">Ḥull. VIII, 3</cite> <he>נ׳ את הקדרה</he> if he stirred (the meat in) the pot. Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᵈ top <he>שמא נ׳ הגוי בקדרה</he> the gentile might have stirred the pot; a. fr.
Toh. II, 1 מְנָעֶרֶת את הקדרה she may empty (or stir) the dish.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 28:2">Kel. XXVIII, 2</cite> <he>לנָעֵר בו וכ׳</he> used for (lifting and) emptying the pot.

Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 10 שהחנוני מְנָעֵר וכ׳ which the shop-keeper uses when pouring out &c. (or through which he pours for straining), v. יַתִּיךְ; a. e.—נ׳ את הצאן to use means by which to expedite the discharge of excrements of the flock on the spot to be manured (v. דּוּר I, Pi.).
<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 2:20">Tosef. Shebi. II, 20</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 12a">M. Kat. 12ᵃ</cite>; Y. Shebi. III, 34ᶜ bot.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>השוכר … לנַעֲרָהּ</he> he who hires a flock (for manuring) is forbidden to use means &c.; expl.

ib. מוליכה ממקום וכ׳ by driving it from place to place.—Part. pass. מְנוֹעָר; f. מְנוֹעֶרֶת; pl. מְנוֹעָרִים, מְנוֹעָרִין: מְנוֹעָרוֹת empty, vacant. Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵇ bot. (play on שִׁנְ֗עָ֗ר̇) שחם מנ׳ מן המצות וכ׳ they (the Babylonians) are vacant of (cannot perform) certain religious observances &c.; Koh. R. to XII, 7; Gen. R. s. 37 שהיא מנ׳ וכ׳ she (Babylonia) is deprived &c.

<cite ref="Chagigah 14a:13">Ḥag. 14ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>נערים</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 3:4">Is. III, 4</cite>) <he>אלו בני אדם שמנ׳ וכ׳</he> that means persons empty of good deeds, opp. <he>ממולא</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 261">Yalk. Is. 261</cite>.—[<cite ref="Bava Batra 74b">B. Bath. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>ור״י נוער</he> some ed., v. <cite ref="P00342"><he>עוּר</he> I</cite>.—
<cite ref="Chullin 51b:9">Ḥull. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>ניערה</he>, v. infra.]

senses.gloss: to be stirred up; to bestir one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 74b">B. Bath. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>וני׳ ר״א</he> and R. El. was stirred up (awoke).
<cite ref="Sotah 5a:11">Sot. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>אין עפרו נ׳</he> his dust will not be stirred up (for resurrection).

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:13">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> (play on <he>חלאה ונערה</he>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 4:5">I Chr. IV, 5</cite>) <he>חלתה ונִנְעֲרָה מחליה וכ׳</he> she (Miriam) was sick, but she bestirred herself (arose) from her sickness, and the Lord restored her to youth. Y. Ber. III, 6ᵈ top (play on <he>מנעריו</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 8:21">Gen. VIII, 21</cite>) <he>משעה שהוא נ׳ ויוצא וכ׳</he> from the moment the embryo bestirs itself to come out into the world; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34">Gen. R. s. 34</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 61:10">Yalk. ib. 61</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 51b:9">Ḥull. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>ננערה לעמוד וכ׳</he> Rashi (ed. <he>נִיעֲרָה</he>) if the animal made an effort to get up, although it did not succeed; a. e.

senses.gloss: (of flax) to be hatcheled. Y. Sabb. II, beg. 4ᶜ (expl. חוסן, ib. II, 1) פשתן שלא ננערה flax which has not yet been hatcheled.
to be emptied, poured out. Y. Ber. l. c. (play on שנער) ששם נִנְעֲרוּ וכ׳ for into that valley the dead of the generation of the flood were dumped; Gen. R. s. 37; Koh. R. l. c.—
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 92a:20">Snh. 92ᵃ</cite> <he>קשתו נִינְעֶרֶת</he> his bow will be empty (his sexual vitality broken).
<cite ref="Eruvin 53b:14">Erub. 53ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>נערה</he> &c., v. <cite ref="A00513"><he>אַהֲרוֹנִית</he></cite>) <he>והִנְעִירָתוֹ</he> and she kept him awake.

<cite ref="Zevachim 116a:15">Zeb. 116ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Song of Songs 4:16">Cant. IV, 16</cite>) <he>תִּתְנַעֵר אומה … ותבא וכ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) removed be the (Roman) nation whose sacrifices are slaughtered northward (<cite ref="Leviticus 1:11">Lev. I, 11</cite>, which is entitled only to burnt-offerings), and let the nation enter &c.
